t: This is St Mary Magdalene Gardens, a public open space between Holloway Road and Liverpool Road in Islington. It sits on the old burial ground of St Mary Magdalene Church. Among those buried here is Robert Seymour, who lived from 1798 to 1836. He was an illustrator and caricaturist, known for his illustrations for Charles Dickens's The Pickwick Papers. He died by suicide after arguing with Dickens over those illustrations, so the gardens hold a small piece of Dickens's story.
